name: Doreen
text: Lovely afternoon. My granddaughter has ordered me a paddle. It is purple.

author: graham
text: For the record those were not ping pong bats. They were my father's. I would like them back.

author: jake
text: Mel, don't cap it. Thirty-one people wanting to play is the dream. Set it up as a mixer on [Rallio](https://rallio.io/for-coaches/) and let everyone sign up. It draws the rounds across however many courts you've got and rotates the sit-outs, so everyone gets the same time on court and nobody's stood on the side for twenty minutes. And you'll know it's forty before Sunday, not at 2.10. Happy to set it up with you.

author: terry
text: I did tell you. In the car park. On Thursday. You were talking.

author: mel
text: Terry you said and I quote "good luck with that". That is NOT telling me!!
